text:
Ana (Marketing): FYI — got a ping from a national outlet asking to move our benchmark blog up by 6 hours. They want an embargo lift for their exclusive at 10am PT tomorrow. :eyes:
Kai (PR): Who is the outlet? Any contractual embargo agreement?
Ana (Marketing): It’s 'The Ledger' (requested via email). No formal contract, just the usual embargo - they sent a screenshot.
Lena (Comms): Can you paste the email? Need to see the exact ask.
Ana (Marketing): Copied snippet below:
---
From: editor@theledger.example
Subject: Request to publish exclusively at 10am PT tomorrow
Body: We’d like to run your benchmark story at 10am PT. Can you confirm embargo lift for us?
---
Kai (PR): Thanks. Quick take: The default is stick to our schedule unless we agree to a timed exclusive. Any early lift risks spoiling syndication partners and social cadence.
Ravi (Legal): Does the Ledger have NDA/embargo terms attached in the outreach? If no legal obligation, decision is editorial/comms.
Maya (Social): If we do an early exclusive we need the asset pack ready 1 hour before — hero graphs, gif, and 3 social variants. Can we hit that?
Ana (Marketing): Our current publish time is 4pm PT. Moving to 10am shortens prep. Ops shows scheduled publish at 16:00 PT in the CMS.
publish-bot: scheduled_post.update — post_id=bench-2026-03; old_time=16:00 PT; new_time=16:00 PT (no change)
Kai (PR): Proposal: Offer Ledger a 10am preview (access to embargoed post) but keep live publish at 4pm. That preserves syndication and social. If they insist on exclusive publish, escalate to execs.
Lena (Comms): Agreed. Offer them preview window only. Frame as: "we can provide an embargoed preview for your reporter at 10am PT, but live publication remains 4pm PT to honor partner roster."
Ana (Marketing): @Kai can you send the preview access? I’ll prepare the asset pack for 9am PT (preview-ready).
Kai (PR): Will do. Draft reply: "Happy to provide an embargoed preview at 10am PT. Full publication remains at 4pm PT to coordinate partner distribution. Please confirm your reporter will not publish before 4pm." Thoughts?
Ravi (Legal): Add a short sentence: "This preview is provided under embargo; publication prior to 4pm PT without prior written consent constitutes a breach of embargo." Minimal legal protection.
Maya (Social): I'll stage the social copy and creatives for 15:00 PT publish and keep a short teaser queued for 16:00. If Ledger breaks embargo, we can accelerate social to align.
Ana (Marketing): Action items: Kai send preview access + legal sentence (by EOD), Maya stage assets (by 9am tomorrow), Lena draft press lines to hand to reporter.
Kai (PR): Sending reply now. I’ll cc ops and include a screenshot of the preview.*
Ana (Marketing): Thanks — please paste reply here when sent.
Kai (PR): Sent. Copy pasted below:
---
Hi Editor — happy to provide an embargoed preview at 10am PT tomorrow. Please confirm your reporter will not publish before 4pm PT; preview provided under embargo and publication prior to 4pm PT without written consent is a breach. We will share assets at 9am PT for your review.
Best, Kai
---
Lena (Comms): I’ve drafted two short quotables for the reporter and one longer technical appendix. Uploading to the shared drive now.
Maya (Social): Assets staged. I’ll do a final check 08:45 PT.
publish-bot: notification — assets_uploaded post_id=bench-2026-03 by Maya at 1746543720
Ana (Marketing): Great — closing loop. If Ledger confirms they’ll hold, we proceed with preview-only. If they push to publish at 10am, escalate to execs (CC: CEO) and we’ll decide on exclusive terms. :thumbsup: 
Kai (PR): I’ll monitor. Will flag immediately if they push for a hard exclusive.
Lena (Comms): Also note: partner newsletter window 16:15 PT—don’t move.
Ana (Marketing): Noted. Thanks everyone. Leaving thread open for any last-minute changes.
Maya (Social): standing by."
